XMLDB.COMMENT: Database tables for the Mnemo (VR cyberspace) course format.

TABLE.NAME: format_mnemo_building
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-activity building model overrides for the Mnemo cyberspace scene.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course module the building model is attached to.

FIELD.NAME: model
FIELD.COMMENT: A .glb model file name (resolved against the asset pack) or a full URL. May be empty when only an in-view transform is set.

FIELD.NAME: scale
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view uniform scale multiplier for the activity's object.

FIELD.NAME: scalex
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view width (x) multiplier, applied on top of the uniform scale.

FIELD.NAME: scaley
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view height (y) multiplier, applied on top of the uniform scale.

FIELD.NAME: scalez
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view depth (z) multiplier, applied on top of the uniform scale.

FIELD.NAME: offsetx
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view world-x offset from the object's default position.

FIELD.NAME: offsety
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view world-y offset from the object's default position.

FIELD.NAME: offsetz
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view world-z offset from the object's default position.

FIELD.NAME: rotation
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view extra rotation about the vertical axis, in degrees.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: When the override was last set.

TABLE.NAME: format_mnemo_sceneobj
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-course in-view transforms for non-activity scene objects (props, gates, pylons).

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course the scene object belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: objkey
FIELD.COMMENT: A stable per-course slot key, e.g. lamp:3, kiosk:1, gate:0.

FIELD.NAME: scale
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view uniform scale multiplier.

FIELD.NAME: scalex
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view width (x) multiplier, applied on top of the uniform scale.

FIELD.NAME: scaley
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view height (y) multiplier, applied on top of the uniform scale.

FIELD.NAME: scalez
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view depth (z) multiplier, applied on top of the uniform scale.

FIELD.NAME: offsetx
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view world-x offset from the default position.

FIELD.NAME: offsety
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view world-y offset from the default position.

FIELD.NAME: offsetz
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view world-z offset from the default position.

FIELD.NAME: rotation
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view extra rotation about the vertical axis, in degrees.

FIELD.NAME: brightness
FIELD.COMMENT: In-view brightness multiplier for light-emitting objects.

FIELD.NAME: hidden
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether a generated prop at this slot has been removed from the course (1 = hidden).

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: When the override was last set.

TABLE.NAME: format_mnemo_placedobj
TABLE.COMMENT: Teacher-placed decorative props for the Mnemo cyberspace scene, per course.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course the placed prop belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: The prop model name: lamp, barrier, kiosk or av.

FIELD.NAME: basex
FIELD.COMMENT: Grid-snapped world-x where the prop was placed.

FIELD.NAME: basez
FIELD.COMMENT: Grid-snapped world-z where the prop was placed.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the prop was placed.
